categories.main_business_segments: erex Co., Ltd. operates four integrated business segments: retail electricity sales, power generation (primarily biomass and some coal-fired plants), fuel procurement and trading (mainly biomass fuels such as PKS and wood pellets), and electricity/fuel trading. The company also actively develops overseas renewable energy projects, especially in Southeast Asia.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages expertise in biomass power generation, including the use of PKS and wood pellets, and operates under Japan's FIT (Feed-in Tariff) scheme for renewable energy. It has established direct procurement and production capabilities for biomass fuels, including FSC-certified wood pellet manufacturing in Vietnam, and employs advanced trading and risk management techniques for electricity and fuel markets.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include both corporate and individual electricity consumers across Japan, with a focus on high-voltage (industrial/commercial) and low-voltage (residential/SME) segments. The company also supplies electricity and biomass fuels to other power producers and utilities, and is expanding into Southeast Asian markets, targeting local utilities and industrial clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: erex's core operations are in Japan, covering all major regions (including Okinawa and Hokkaido), with expanding activities in Southeast Asia, particularly Vietnam and Cambodia. The company also has subsidiaries in Singapore and Malaysia for fuel procurement and trading.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the energy supply chain: upstream in biomass fuel production and procurement, midstream in power generation, and downstream in electricity retail and trading. It also engages in trading of carbon credits and plans to expand aggregation and energy management services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating decarbonization, expanding renewable energy (especially biomass and hydro), developing overseas projects, and strengthening the stable supply and cost competitiveness of biomass fuels. R&D focuses on new biomass fuel development, energy management systems (including battery storage), and carbon credit trading. The company aims to become a leading decarbonization solutions provider by 2050.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through electricity sales (retail and wholesale), sales of biomass fuels, and trading activities. The company also earns from long-term fuel supply contracts, and plans to monetize environmental value through carbon credit trading and aggregation services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: erex competes with major Japanese electric utilities, new power producers, and trading companies in both electricity retail and renewable power generation. It positions itself as a pioneer and leader in biomass power and renewable energy integration, with a growing presence in Southeast Asia. The company differentiates itself through its integrated business model and expertise in biomass fuel supply.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue was ¥171.2 billion, with a return to profitability (net income attributable to owners: ¥2.1 billion) after a loss in the previous year. The company has approximately 284 employees and a solid capital base, with recent capital increases and a focus on overseas investment. While revenue declined year-on-year due to market factors, profitability and cash flow improved significantly.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: erex emphasizes its ability to provide stable, cost-competitive, and sustainable renewable energy, particularly through integrated biomass fuel supply and power generation. Its unique value lies in its end-to-end control of the biomass supply chain, innovative trading and risk management, and commitment to decarbonization and environmental value creation, both domestically and internationally.
